headline: Argentina beat Cape Verde 3-2 in extra-time to reach World Cup last 16
summary: Reigning champions Argentina narrowly defeated rank outsiders Cape Verde 3-2 after extra-time, with an own goal sealing their progression to the World Cup last 16.
details: Lionel Messi's Argentina secured a hard-fought 3-2 victory against rank outsiders Cape Verde after extra-time. This epic contest saw the reigning champions advance to the World Cup last 16.
The decisive moment came in the 111th minute when an own goal from Diney Borges, under pressure from Argentina's Cristian Romero, settled the match. The dramatic win took place in Miami.
Following this narrow escape, Argentina will now prepare to face Egypt in the next round of the tournament.
caption:

headline: Gold price raised for 2nd straight day; each bhori now costs Tk228,556
summary: Gold prices in Bangladesh have increased for the second consecutive day, with each bhori now valued at Tk228,556. This continuous rise reflects current market trends.
details: Gold prices in Bangladesh have seen an upward revision for the second consecutive day, pushing the cost of one bhori to Tk228,556. This significant increase impacts both consumers and investors in the local market.

The continuous rise suggests a volatile market trend, reflecting broader economic factors influencing precious metals. Such fluctuations often lead to shifts in purchasing patterns and investment strategies.
A bhori, a traditional unit of weight for gold, is equivalent to 11.664 grams. The current pricing sets a new benchmark for gold transactions across the country.
